mapper.sql: activity.id, activity.title, activity.status, activity.position, activity.score_can_get, activity.enroll_num_limit, activity.activity_belong_to_school_id, school_info.name AS activity_belong_to_school_name, activity.activity_belong_to_organization_id, organization_info.name AS activity_belong_to_organization_name, activity.activity_belong_to_college_id, college_info.name AS activity_belong_to_college_name, activity.create_time, activity.update_time, activity.description, activity.enroll_need_review, activity.need_sign_out, activity.attachment, activity.category_id, activity.cover_img, activity.paid_flag, activity.price_fen, activity.refund_policy

activity_schedule.enroll_start_time, activity_schedule.enroll_end_time, activity_schedule.activity_start_time, activity_schedule.activity_end_time, activity_schedule.signin_start_time, activity_schedule.signin_end_time, activity_schedule.signout_start_time, activity_schedule.signout_end_time

FROM activity LEFT JOIN activity_schedule ON activity.id = activity_schedule.activity_id AND activity_schedule.deleted_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN school_info ON activity.activity_belong_to_school_id = school_info.id LEFT JOIN organization_info ON activity.activity_belong_to_organization_id = organization_info.id LEFT JOIN college_info ON activity.activity_belong_to_college_id = college_info.id

mapper.select:

WHERE activity.deleted_flag = 0
AND INSTR(activity.title, #{queryForm.keyword})
AND activity.status = #{queryForm.status}
ORDER BY activity.create_time DESC, activity.id DESC
